summary: Upwork Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a $150 million secured revolving credit facility with Bank of America as administrative agent, maturing June 23, 2029. Borrowings bear interest at Term SOFR plus 2.00%-2.50% or Base Rate plus 1.00%-1.50%, based on net leverage. Proceeds support working capital, debt repurchases, and potential acquisitions. Collateral covers substantially all domestic assets. This is a routine credit agreement, not a special situation event; no acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved.
